beats.say: 1.9 billion people watched the global jukebox concert in 1985.
Bob Geldof and Midge Ure organised the massive event to raise funds for famine relief in Ethiopia.
On 13 July 1985, the world tuned in to Wembley Stadium and John F. Kennedy Stadium.
Queen took the stage at Wembley, delivering a performance that became the highlight of the day.
It was the ultimate global jukebox, bringing the world together.

facts: Bob Geldof and Midge Ure organised the Live Aid concert.
The event took place on 13 July 1985.
It was held at Wembley Stadium in London and John F. Kennedy Stadium in Philadelphia.
An estimated audience of 1.9 billion people in 150 nations watched the live broadcast.
The concert was held to raise funds for famine relief in Ethiopia.
The concert was billed as the global jukebox.

es.title: La legendaria actuación de Queen en Live Aid 🎤
es.summary: Queen actuó en el Wembley Stadium durante Live Aid el 13 de julio de 1985, cautivando a 1.9 mil millones de espectadores en todo el mundo y convirtiéndose en el acto más grande de la noche.

pt.title: A lendária performance do Queen no Live Aid 🎤
pt.summary: O Queen se apresentou no Wembley Stadium durante o Live Aid em 13 de julho de 1985, cativando 1.9 bilhão de espectadores em todo o mundo e se tornando a maior atração da noite.

hi.title: Queen का शानदार Live Aid प्रदर्शन 🎤
hi.summary: Queen ने 13 जुलाई 1985 को Live Aid के दौरान Wembley Stadium में प्रदर्शन किया, जिसने दुनिया भर के 1.9 अरब दर्शकों को मंत्रमुग्ध कर दिया और वे उस रात के सबसे बड़े कलाकार बन गए।
